commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single inventory item sprite for a 16-bit RPG. All four input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 scratch paper, image 2 half an eraser, image 3 anomalous feather, image 4 ornate golden key. Create a NEW subject specified below; do not reproduce any reference object. Match these references closely: refined 16-bit console RPG pixel art, clean connected pixel clusters, restrained 4-6 stepped shades per material, warm dark brown-plum outlines, cream highlights, muted indigo shadows, richly shaded surfaces with readable thickness. Crisp stair-stepped contours and small square specular highlights. A logical grid approximately 48-64 pixels wide, enlarged with nearest-neighbor sampling. No antialiasing, blur, gradients, vector strokes, smooth curves, 3D rendering, neon outlines, outer glow, colored rarity frame, ground shadow, labels, watermark, or additional objects. Single isolated item centered, at a slight diagonal or three-quarter view as appropriate, occupying approximately 75 percent of the canvas, with clear empty margins. Background: a completely solid flat chroma-key green #00FF00, including any holes inside the item; NO checkerboard, scenery, floor, or background texture. Do not use green in the subject itself. The green will be removed locally to create a transparent PNG. Subject:

items.window-seat: A worn ivory window-seat reservation pass with subtly torn paper corners, indigo-blue border, and a small pixel stamp showing a sunlit window beside a seat. Paper folds and layered cream/tan shadows, no readable letters. It must read as a physical seat voucher, not a freestanding window or chair.
items.school-badge: A small university motto badge: a substantial brass-gold shield pin, muted indigo enamel inset and a tiny open-book emblem. Stepped metallic highlights, dark recessed engraving, visible clasp thickness. No lettering, ribbons or invented university logo.
items.gpa-charm: An academic good-luck talisman with a gold metal frame, muted violet inset stone, tiny top loop and short cream cord. The inset bears only compact engraved pixel digits 4.0. Layered gold and violet facets with small cream highlights; no magical glow.
items.library-reward-ticket: A warm ochre library seat-reservation ticket with notched ends and a short perforated edge, cream paper inset, a dark indigo open-book seal and a few small illegible ink strokes. It should feel like a collectible ticket for reserving a study seat in a campus library. Fine layered paper shadows and a subtle worn corner. No legible lettering.
items.portable-medkit: A compact off-white canvas first-aid pouch with a short top carry handle, brown seams, dark indigo zipper and a small muted red medical cross patch. Squared but soft fabric silhouette, stepped folds, layered cream and taupe shading. No writing.
items.morning-coffee: A small takeaway morning coffee cup with a cream lid, warm brown paper sleeve, visible ivory paper body, and two tiny stepped curls of pale steam. The sleeve has a small dark coffee-bean emblem. Three-quarter view, layered coffee-brown shadows; no text.
items.torn-notebook: A weathered half-torn pocket notebook with a muted indigo-violet cloth cover, exposed ivory pages, visible brown binding, ragged missing corners and a few faded indigo ink marks. Clearly a bound notebook rather than loose scratch paper. Layered page edges and warm cream highlights; no readable text.
items.training-bat: A sturdy wooden practice stick diagonally from lower left to upper right, rounded blunt tip, thicker wooden shaft and short ivory-cloth wrapped grip. Warm walnut and honey-brown stepped wood grain, small cream top-left highlights and a dark brown outline. No blades, spikes or decorative effects.
items.stun-baton: A compact handheld electric stun device with a dark indigo housing, two short brass contact prongs at the top, one small muted blue indicator and a textured brown-black grip. Visible stepped casing thickness and cream specular pixels. No electric bolts or glow, no text.
items.bandage: A single beige adhesive bandage placed diagonally, with rounded stepped ends, an ivory raised gauze pad at the center and a few precisely spaced tiny darker perforation pixels. Cream, tan and warm taupe layered shading, dark warm brown outline. No medical case or roll.
items.yellow-bike: A small yellow campus bicycle in readable three-quarter side view, brass-yellow frame, dark indigo tires with open wheel centers, cream metallic spokes, small brown saddle and dark handlebars. Both complete wheels fit comfortably inside the canvas. Clear connected pixel clusters and stepped metal highlights; no rider, scenery or ground shadow.
items.thick-down-jacket: A very thick slate-blue padded down jacket with short splayed sleeves, raised cream fleece collar, center brass zipper and clearly shaded horizontal quilted baffles. Bulky readable silhouette, indigo shadows, dusty blue midtones and cream-blue highlights, dark warm brown outline. No wearer, hanger, labels or text.
